description: Defines the FileUploadForm class for handling media file uploads within Drupal's media library module, including form building, validation, processing, and media entity creation.

classes.name: FileUploadForm
classes.description: A form class for uploading files and creating media entities in Drupal's media library.

methods.name: getFormId
methods.description: Returns the unique form ID for the upload form.

methods.name: getMediaType
methods.description: Retrieves the media type, ensuring it uses a file field as source.

methods.name: buildInputElement
methods.description: Builds the form input elements for file upload, including validators and UI elements.

methods.name: validateUploadElement
methods.description: Validates the uploaded files, enforcing maximum file count.

methods.name: processUploadElement
methods.description: Processes the upload element, adding AJAX callbacks and submit handlers.

methods.name: buildEntityFormElement
methods.description: Builds form elements for media entities, hiding extra source field components.

methods.name: hideExtraSourceFieldComponents
methods.description: Hides unnecessary components in source field elements for cleaner UI.

methods.name: uploadButtonSubmit
methods.description: Handles the submission of uploaded files, creating file entities.

methods.name: createMediaFromValue
methods.description: Creates a media entity from a file, moving the file to the correct directory.

methods.name: createFileItem
methods.description: Creates a new file field item based on media type.

methods.name: prepareMediaEntityForSave
methods.description: Sets the media's file as permanent before saving.

methods.name: removeButtonSubmit
methods.description: Handles removal of media and deletes the file if unused.
